lines.text: Hey Alex, thanks for helping get the prototype ready. The leadership demo is this afternoon.
Looking forward to it. I just checked the slides.
The project slide says you designed and built it. Could we put both our names there? I built the backend and the demo flow.
I came up with the idea and I'm presenting it. Listing everyone will make the slide too busy.
I'll mention your help if someone asks about implementation.
Can you run the live demo while I present? And let's not get into who built what in front of leadership, okay?
